latest.title: Multiply warped products with harmonic Weyl tensor and zero radial Weyl curvature
latest.abstract: In this article, we study multiply warped products with a one-dimensional base, harmonic Weyl tensor and zero radial Weyl curvature. We prove that these manifolds have at most three fibers and describe their local geometry. The proof uses a conformal change which makes the warping functions quadratic polynomials, together with the compatibility equations imposed by the Ricci tensor. The resulting metrics are either obtained from locally conformally flat multiply warped products by replacing their space-form fibers with Einstein manifolds, or belong to a three-fiber family with equal fiber dimensions and positive Einstein constants. Examples show that the bound is sharp and that neither Weyl condition implies the other. We also discuss the stronger restrictions arising from soliton-type equations.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 分类满足调和 Weyl 与零径向 Weyl 条件的一维底多重扭曲积，证明纤维至多三个。
latest.breakthrough: 给出锐纤维数上界，并分离两项 Weyl 假设的作用。
latest.limitations: 结论依赖两种 Weyl 条件及特定底维数，不能用于一般多重扭曲积。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。 纤维数在合并相差常数倍的扭曲函数后计算。
latest.priorityReason: 曲率方程转为低阶代数结构的技术值得复用。
